deployment: deferred while HS200200MHz error classification is fixed and tested
verified_dependencies: Actual T736 sunxi_mmc_ddr_timing excludes HS400. Generic CTRL.DDR10 must stay0 for HS400; dedicated EDSD31 selects it. CSDC6, CMD180/DATA90, module/card2x and internaldiv0 match actual donor.
Core initial HS200->HS400 transition performs CMD6 HS_TIMING1, hostHS/lowclock, CMD6 BUS_WIDTH8DDR, CMD6 HS_TIMING3, then hostHS400/targetclock and execute_hs400_tuning(host,card).

Core runtime retuning necessarily visits MMC_TIMING_MMC_DDR52 after HS400 is downgraded to HSDDR and before the bus is switched back to8SDR. v22 rejects DDR52; adding HS400 capability alone cannot implement this transition.

8-bit DDR52 transition at50MHz needs CTRL.DDR10=1, DATA180, module200MHz/card4x with internaldiv1, EDSD31=0 and CSDC3. Support the transient without advertising an unvalidated standalone DDR52 operating mode.
execute_hs400_tuning receives card explicitly before host->card is assigned on initial card setup. Use callback card; do not dereference host->card for initialization recovery.
Core invokes execute_hs400_tuning before final CMD13 switch-status and disables retuning around that callback. Ordinary data gating must preserve non-data CMD6/CMD13 protocol transitions.

Mainline MTK uses mmc_get_ext_csd(card) reads to scan HS400 strobe delay. T736 proposal adds fresh poisoned DMA and immutable core-established EXT_CSD field comparisons; full512-byte equality across mode switches is invalid.

CMD13 tuning must use exported __mmc_send_status(card,&status,0); mmc_send_status retries failed commands and could hide bad taps. R1 validity also explicitly rejects SWITCH_ERRORbit7, which R1_STATUS0xFFF9A000 excludes.
Existing final v22 DT includes PC0 in emmc-pins withmux4; manual PC0_SELECT0100 is SDC3-DS. This establishes configured pin routing, not a physical DQS waveform measurement.
A733 SAMP_DL/DS_DL[13:8] are not a documented DLL calibration control. Keep them unchanged and use only documented software-enable and six-bit delay fields.
required_implementation_review: Keep HS400 opt-in and dependent on accepted HS200200MHz; no HS400ES/CQE/shared PLL or rail changes.
Track separately valid command and DS eyes; invalidate on mode/frequency changes; only requested tuning CMD8 reads pass data gate until both succeed.
Keep linear64tap/20success/min12/16center policy and explicit true-time bounds; never treat seeded taps or a CRC-failed transfer as validated.
Use final separately reviewed v23 recovery classification for expected raw card CRC/timeout errors. Unexplained summaries, unknown bits, descriptor errors and controller faults remain fatal.
Audit all initial and runtime retune transitions with correct internal/module divider and clock-disable ordering; no manual unreviewed CMD6 recovery sequence.
Match only core-established read-only EXT_CSD fields; free every allocated response and preserve DMA reset/quarantine on all paths.
Validate subsequent filesystem reads and writes separately; CMD8 strobe tuning is read-only and does not qualify the write path.
result_boundary: This is a design review only. No HS400 driver implementation, compile check, tuning eye, throughput or hardware acceptance is established.
